facts.text: Pulse Concert is performed by Pink Floyd.
Artist: Pink Floyd · Title: Pulse Concert · Album: Pulse · Year: 1994 · Genre: Concert · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Pink Floyd - Pulse Concert.mp4
"High Hopes" is a song by English rock band Pink Floyd, composed by guitarist David Gilmour with lyrics by Gilmour and Polly Samson.
It is the closing track on their fourteenth studio album, The Division Bell (1994); it was released as the second single from the album on 10 October 1994.
An accompanying music video was made for the song and was directed by Storm Thorgerson.
The discography of the English rock group Pink Floyd consists of 15 studio albums, seven live albums, 18 compilation albums, 11 box sets, three EPs, and 27 singles.
Formed in 1965, Pink Floyd earned recognition for their psychedelic or space rock music, and, later, their progressive rock music.
The group have sold over 250 million records worldwide, including 75 million in the United States.
Pink Floyd are an English rock band founded in late 1965 by Syd Barrett on guitar and lead vocals, Nick Mason on drums, Roger Waters on bass and vocals, and Richard Wright on keyboards and vocals.
Guitarist and vocalist David Gilmour would later join the band in December 1967, while Barrett was ousted from the band in April 1968 due to deteriorating mental health.
